# Project instructions

Apply these only to this repository. Read `AGENTS.md` and the canonical studio
skill under `.github\skills\emotional-microfilm\SKILL.md`.
Resume from the roadmap, relevant workflow, actual feedback and selected manifest.

The studio is multi-genre: emotion, comedy/memes, nostalgia, poetry, mystery and
other approved lanes. Visual style and optional subtle local texture are separate
choices. Do not force every film into sadness, a twist or the same music.

Pacing, lighting/shadows, sound/song choice, evidence and review gates are first-
class production work. Keep their rules, sources and state project-local.
No generation, upload, spend or publication without its actual approval.

Use `docs\agent-integration.md` for the common Claude/ChatGPT/Copilot contract,
capability checks, private handoff and single-writer ownership. Claim an existing
workspace and set `FILM_OWNER` before CLI writes; never take over active provider
jobs or overwrite concurrent changes. A documented host is not a tested host.

Keep genuine personal `*-user` and explicitly scoped `*-delegated` acceptance
distinct. Never promote legacy delegated labels to personal approval. Final
`final-user` acceptance needs actual user viewing; publication remains separate.
Use `docs\entertainment-review.md` and the read-only Wow & Enjoyment Analyst:
actual playback/timecoded reward, beauty, enjoyment, boredom and replay evidence,
not dopamine claims or a guessed pass from frames.

`scripts\audio.mjs` prepares cleared local audio with bounded tempo/fades/level
checks; it does not sing, license or listen. Effects routes and demonstration
limits live in `docs\visual-development.md`. Keep unfinished real host/reference/
voice/effect/viewer work visible in the completion plan and roadmap.

After workflow changes run check, tests and validation; obtain approval before
expensive/full checks. Commit/push only the explicitly authorized session delta;
preserve other sessions' edits and keep production media/credentials private.
